### Houlihan Lokey Continues to Grow Equity Capital Solutions Platform With Experienced Hire


September 15, 2026


**Emil Fajersson Joins as a Managing Director, Expanding Firm’s GP-Led Secondaries Advisory Capabilities**


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Emil Fajersson has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Mr. Fajersson is based in New York and will join as a senior leader in the Equity Capital Solutions team as part of the firm’s continued expansion in GP-led secondaries advisory.


“Houlihan Lokey’s advancing market share in secondaries demonstrates its success at attracting individuals who share a cultural compatibility with the firm and possess the market relationships and execution expertise that clients value and expect. We are excited that Emil has chosen to join us and help Houlihan Lokey reach its goal of establishing the premier secondaries advisory platform in financial services,” said Gregg Newman, Managing Director and Global Co-Head of Houlihan Lokey’s Capital Solutions Group.


Mr. Fajersson joins the firm from Northleaf Capital Partners, where he was a Managing Director and Head of GP-led investments & Co-investments as well as Portfolio Manager of Northleaf’s Capital Opportunities Fund. Prior experience also includes serving as Principal at Vision Capital, a middle-market private equity firm, as well as roles with UBS Investment Bank, and with Macquarie’s infrastructure investment group.


“Over the past two years, we have substantially grown our secondaries advisory capabilities with extraordinarily talented individuals who embody our client-first ethos and value the strength and momentum we’ve achieved in Equity Capital Solutions. Having worked across the table from Emil on a number of deals for the better part of a decade, I could not be more excited that he is now a partner and a key element of our efforts to further grow our GP-led secondaries advisory capabilities in North America,” said Matt Swain, Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Solutions.


“The acceleration in GP-led secondaries activity over the past two years demonstrates the meaningful maturation of this market, driven in no small part by increasingly broad participation and the substantial opportunities that exist for these investors. I am excited to join the team to further grow our GP-led secondaries coverage capabilities,” said Mr. Fajersson.


Houlihan Lokey’s Capital Solutions Group comprises more than 240 dedicated professionals across 19 offices in eight countries, including Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Dubai, Frankfurt, Houston, London, Los Angeles, Madrid, Manchester, Miami, Milan, Munich, New York, Paris, San Francisco, West Palm Beach, and Zurich. In the past 12 months, the group raised and advised on over $35 billion across more than 135 transactions.*


**As of June 30, 2026.*


**About Houlihan Lokey**


Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
